about_the_game:
What Is It?

Anima Codex is your world building and story telling companion!

An intuitive tool designed for Writers, Gamemasters and Creators who want to bring their universe to life!

Who's it for?

  • Novelists and Writers

  • Game Developers

  • Dungeon Masters

  • Creative Thinkers

Features:

  • World Builder - Create and Describe your worlds

  • Location Manager - Describe Regions, Cities and Landmarks in as much detail as you desire

  • Character Profiles - Track relationships, personalities, roles and much more

  • Item Library -  Document relics, tools and artifacts important to your setting

  • Inspector - Easy and simple to use inspector loading system

Future features:

Will be added;

  • Timelines - A Graphical Timeline, showcasing major or minor events that occurred during your universe

  • Quests - Simple Quest making system 

Wants;

  • Tagging System - Add Tags to each creation, allowing you associate with each other and simple searching

  • Species Editor - Allow you to create different species within your universe

  • Duplicating - Allow you to duplicate entries  

  • Reference System - Allow you to cross reference between the different categories by name

Additional notes:

This software is being developed by one person and I am always looking for feedback and suggestions. I'd be honored to receive any feedback and suggestions posted in the Steam forum section(And possibly discord if i decide to make a group)
